company_notes:
Summary: AxonIDE is a mid-market devtools company building an enterprise-grade IDE copilot for internal developer productivity and customer-facing tooling. Want an on-prem, air-gapped deployment for code completion and streaming completions with strong model pinning controls. POC scope: offline installer, model weight packaging, kernel/quantization recommendations for 8-16K context models, low-latency streaming to IDEs (50-120ms token p99 target), and a rollout plan for periodic offline model updates (signed bundles).

Key quotes / call snippets: "We cannot have outbound calls from the inference plane — all updates must be bundle-based and signed." "Latency is critical — devs will abandon the copilot if completion lag exceeds 150ms p95."

Technical asks: hardware sizing guidance for mixed dev/test workloads; packaging that supports air-gapped installers and verifiable integrity (SBOM + signing); a deterministic offline update process (signed bundles + migration instructions); model pinning per team with rollbacks. Also asked about offline telemetry options (local logs + periodic encrypted export).

Procurement notes: prefer Opex monthly billing for POC then convert to 12mo dedicated reserved contract. Budget target mid five-figures for POC.

Sticking points: vendor comparison with LocalCopilot (self-hosted) and internal infra team wanting to do proof of concept using open-source runtime; hardware lead times may push pilot start by 2-3 weeks.

Action items recorded: 1) SE to deliver detailed hardware bill-of-material & perf projection (Rajat) by 2024-11-08. 2) AE to share draft SOW and 30-day airgap installer runbook. 3) Security to be supplied with SBOM + HSM/KMS integration notes.
